terminals.name: claxedo-server
terminals.description: Self-hosted Claxedo control plane (embedded OpenCode engine + SQLite) on http://127.0.0.1:2593 -- the backend the web app talks to.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd packages/claxedo-server && bun run dev

terminals.name: claxedo-app
terminals.description: Claxedo web app (Solid + Vite dev server) on http://localhost:4444, proxying API routes to the control plane on 2593.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd packages/claxedo-app && bun run dev
